thesis: The speaker argues that the field is currently zero to two major breakthroughs away from achieving artificial general intelligence (AGI). He defines AGI as a system capable of human-level competence across all tasks, noting that while machines have surpassed humans in specific domains like arithmetic and chess, the goal remains flexible general intelligence.
